[P3] Preserve own-property semantics when merging log fields

A plugin returning `{ ["__proto__"]: "value" }` satisfies the declared return type, but `Object.assign` invokes the inherited `__proto__` setter and silently discards this field. The previous spread preserved it as an own enumerable property, so this changes `getLogEnrichment()` and the fields forwarded to custom loggers. Merge the staged copy using data-property definitions, such as `Object.defineProperties` with `Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors`, and add a regression test for this key.
